description: Orthanc public demo server study 'RT^HEAD_NECK (Adult)', patient HN_P001: head/neck CT (198 slices, uncompressed), an RTSTRUCT and an RTDOSE in one study. citation: Jodogne S. The Orthanc Ecosystem for Medical Imaging. J Digit Imaging. 2018;31(3):341-352. Public demo server: https://orthanc.uclouvain.be/demo/

files.note: archive zip is regenerated per request (not byte-stable); sha256 intentionally null, contents verified via extracted_sha256

dicomweb.procedure: GET {wado_rs_study}/series/{SeriesInstanceUID} with Accept: multipart/related; type="application/dicom" and split the multipart body on the boundary; the server does NOT support single-part Accept: application/dicom (400). Per-instance Orthanc REST alternative: GET {base_without_dicom-web}/instances/{orthancId}/file.

description: Orthanc public demo server study 'Neck^1HEAD_NECK_PETCT', patient COMUNIX: PET WB (83) + CT HEAD/NK (83), for PET/CT fusion and a second DICOMweb implementation.
